cohort: Women who gave birth in 2019 and 2020
finding: Anti-pandemic interventions implemented during the first and second waves of the COVID-19 pandemic were associated with an increased frequency of planned caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The increase in caesarean sections was most notable in Robson group 5 (maternal rejection of vaginal delivery after previous caesarean) and Robson group 2b (elective caesarean).
